subject: humanities
passage: Anna Mary Robertson Moses spent most of her life working on farms in New York and Virginia. Taking up painting seriously in her late seventies, ______ Her bright, detailed scenes of country life were being shown in New York galleries within just a few years.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

choices.B: fame came to her under the name "Grandma Moses."
choices.C: her paintings of rural life made her famous as "Grandma Moses."
choices.D: the name "Grandma Moses" became well known.

explanation.why: The introductory phrase "Taking up painting seriously in her late seventies" describes the person who took up painting, so that person must be named right after the comma. Only one choice begins with "she," meaning Moses.
explanation.A: Correct. "She" (Moses) comes right after the introductory phrase, so it is clear she took up painting.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This choice says fame took up painting; the modifier must describe Moses herself.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This choice says her paintings took up painting, which makes no sense.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This choice says the name "Grandma Moses" took up painting, which makes no sense.
